user.title: Set up your home
user.description: Pick the person to track and how to tell they are home. Add rooms and places afterwards from the integration page.

data_description.person: Whose presence this tracks. Entities are named after them.
data_description.home_zone: The person is home while their tracker is in this zone.
data_description.home_ssids: The person is home while their phone is on any of these networks.

ssids.title: Phone Wi-Fi sensors
ssids.description: Sensors found from the person's devices are filled in. Leave empty to use zones only.

data_description.ssid_sensors: Sensors reporting the network the person's phone is on (e.g. the Companion app's Wi-Fi connection sensor).

data_description.home_zone: The person is home while their tracker is in this zone.
data_description.home_ssids: The person is home while their phone is on any of these networks.

data_description.crossing_window: How far back from a room going empty a sensor edge counts as the way out (seconds).
data_description.move_window: After a room goes empty, presence in another room within this time is a move, not leaving (seconds).
data_description.recently_left_duration: How long just left lasts before the person is away (seconds).
data_description.sleep_quiet: In bed with no movement for this long means asleep (seconds).
data_description.bed_leave_grace: Leaving the bed spot for longer than this wakes (seconds).
data_description.exit_pre_window: Presence unavailable: an exit needs motion this soon before the exit sensor (seconds).
data_description.exit_quiet: Presence unavailable: no motion for this long after the exit sensor means left (seconds).
data_description.exit_door_on_time: Presence unavailable: the exit sensor must stay on at least this long (seconds).
data_description.entry_window: Presence unavailable: motion must follow the exit sensor this soon to count as an entry (seconds).
data_description.exclusive_quiet: Leaving an exclusive room for a neighbour that never emptied needs the exclusive room quiet this long (seconds).
data_description.shower_window: A shower's humidity rise is measured from the lowest reading in this window (seconds).
data_description.shower_end: No new humidity high for this long ends a shower (seconds).
data_description.shower_rise: Humidity points above the window's lowest reading that start a shower.
data_description.rebuild_lookback: Hours of recorder history replayed to rebuild the state.
data_description.entry_needs_crossing: Only count a room going occupied from outside as an entry if one of its exit sensors triggered just before.

data_description.person: Whose presence this tracks. Entities are named after them.
data_description.ssid_sensors: Sensors reporting the network the person's phone is on (e.g. the Companion app's Wi-Fi connection sensor).

abort.single_person: Only one person per home is supported for now.

data_description.name: Also names the room's location value and its device.
data_description.area_id: Optional. The room's device is placed in this area.
data_description.presence: Sensors that are on while someone is in the room (e.g. an mmWave zone). The room is occupied while any is on.
data_description.motion: Optional. Used to tell entries and exits apart while the presence sensors are unavailable.
data_description.exits: Optional. Sensors at the doors out of the home. Leaving the home is only recognised from rooms with exit sensors.
data_description.bathroom: Detect showers in this room from a humidity sensor.
data_description.exclusive: While this room is occupied it wins over neighbouring rooms whose sensors pick it up through the wall.

data_description.area_id: Optional. The room's device is placed in this area.
data_description.presence: Sensors that are on while someone is in the room (e.g. an mmWave zone). The room is occupied while any is on.

data_description.humidity: A shower starts when this rises quickly. Leave empty to skip shower detection.

spots.title: Spots
spots.description: Places inside the room with their own sensor. Current: {spots}.

data_description.name: Also names the spot's location value (e.g. bed, desk).
data_description.sensor: On while someone is at this spot (e.g. an mmWave zone).
data_description.role: A bed spot also detects sleep.

data_description.stillness: Optional. Watches the bed; no movement for the sleep stillness time means asleep.
data_description.sleep_entities: Optional. When all of these turn off while in bed, that means asleep (e.g. lights).

error.name_reserved: That name is a built-in location. Pick another.
error.name_taken: A room, spot or place already has that name.
error.spot_name_taken: This room already has a spot with that name.
error.presence_required: Pick at least one presence sensor.

data_description.name: Also names the place's location value.
data_description.ssids: The phone on any of these networks is here.
data_description.zones: The person in any of these zones is here.
data_description.mode: Any: a network or a zone is enough. All: needs both.
data_description.priority: Lower wins when several places match.

data_description.name: Also names the place's location value.
data_description.ssids: The phone on any of these networks is here.
data_description.zones: The person in any of these zones is here.
data_description.mode: Any: a network or a zone is enough. All: needs both.
data_description.priority: Lower wins when several places match.

error.name_reserved: That name is a built-in location. Pick another.
error.name_taken: A room, spot or place already has that name.
error.place_needs_ssid_or_zone: Give at least one Wi-Fi network or zone.

not_loaded.message: Room presence is not set up or not loaded.

nothing_to_set.message: Give a location, an activity, or both.

invalid_location.message: {value} is not a location of this home. Use a room, spot or place name, home or away.

invalid_activity.message: {value} cannot be set. Use asleep or awake.

set_state.name: Set state
set_state.description: Correct the location and/or activity, now or after a delay. Inference continues from the new state.

location.name: Location
location.description: A room, spot or place name (as a slug, e.g. bed), home or away.

activity.name: Activity
activity.description: Asleep or awake. Asleep without a location means the bed.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Seconds to wait before applying. A new call cancels a pending one; a pending call does not survive a restart.
